name: Mission classification
criterion: Agency/authority concurrence: IVa or IVb/IVc depending life investigation and Special Region access

name: Validated full-assembly irradiation
criterion: Bioburden-reduction qualification based on target organisms and approved endpoint, not assumed 100% kill

name: Worst-case internal dose mapping
criterion: Minimum biological dose and maximum component dose measured throughout structural nose, potting and battery pack

name: Post-irradiation acceptance
criterion: Science calibration, memory, controller, cells, heater, canopy and potting survive irradiation + Mars cold + impact

name: Cleanliness and contamination barriers
criterion: Bioburden assays, barrier integrity, storage/transport and integration recontamination prevention
